 Formula One 2026 São Paulo Grand Prix: Formula One 2026 – live
 🏎️ Updates from Interlagos (race due to start 5pm GMT)
 🏎️ Email Daniel | Sign up for The Recap 
 LIVE  Updated  now Daniel Harris Sun 8 Nov 2026 13.32 EST First published on Sun 8 Nov 2026 11.00 EST Share Key events 1h ago ANTONELLI SPINS! 
 2h ago The starting grid 
 3h ago Preamble 
 British driver Lando Norris leads the Sao Paulo Formula One Grand Prix at the Jose Carlos Pace racetrack, aka Interlagos, in Sao Paulo. Photograph: Miguel Schincariol/AFP/Getty Images View image in fullscreen British driver Lando Norris leads the Sao Paulo Formula One Grand Prix at the Jose Carlos Pace racetrack, aka Interlagos, in Sao Paulo. Photograph: Miguel Schincariol/AFP/Getty Images Daniel Harris Sun 8 Nov 2026 13.32 EST First published on Sun 8 Nov 2026 11.00 EST Share Key events 1h ago ANTONELLI SPINS! 
 2h ago The starting grid 
 3h ago Preamble 
 now 13.32 EST Lap 66/71 Antonelli is noted for a late release; Mercedes probably saw that coming and ordered Russell past partly for that reason. Further back, meanwhile, Hulkenberg flies past Lindblad and into the points in 10th.
 Share 2m ago 13.30 EST Lap 65/71 Oh, and Antonelli is ordered aside, Russell’s extra pace giving him a chance of making the podium. Oh, and then we cut to Hamilton spinning; he goes off the track but he returns still ninth, just 25s behind Leclerc now.
 Share 3m ago 13.28 EST Lap 64/71 Norris leads by 12.4s, and he’s surely going to win from here. Russell, meanwhile, who went on to intermediates sooner, is moving up; he’s fifth, 0.8s behind Antonelli.
 Share 4m ago 13.27 EST Lap 63/71 Antonelli comes in but does he get in Colapinto’s road when he comes out? Perhaps…
 Share 5m ago 13.26 EST Lap 62/71 Verstappen’s expected in to change tyres … but he opts to stop out. Norris, though, comes in and, with his lead, will come out in front. He takes intermediates, so needs it to keep raining.
 Share 7m ago 13.25 EST Lap 61/71 Antonelli attacks Hadjar, who closes the door well, but he’s got nine more laps of this. I don’t the pace to keep him at bay.
 Share 8m ago 13.24 EST Lap 60/71 Norris has driven very nicely today, minimum fuss and maximum prejudice. I can’t see Verstappen getting close with 11 laps to go.
 Share 9m ago 13.22 EST Lap 59/71 Antonelli is closing on Hadjar, the gap down to 0.6; Norris’ lead at the front is now above 10s.
 Share 10m ago 13.21 EST Lap 58/71 Hamilton, 2.648s behind Leclerc, who’s ninth, tries to get within overtaking range … and there he goes, past on the inside. Leclerc has barely featured in this race, his Ferrari not performing for him.
 Share 12m ago 13.19 EST Lap 57/71 Hadjar is moving better than Verstappen but will he be allowed by Red Bull to attack him? You have to assume not. Norris, though, won’t care, 8.2s in front.
 Share 14m ago 13.18 EST Lap 56/71 Norris leads, from Verstappen, from Hadjar, from Russell, from Antonelli, from Piastri, from Leclerc, from Lawson, from Hamilton, from Hulkenberg.
 Share 15m ago 13.17 EST Lap 55/71 Norris leads Verstappen by 7.3s; Antonelli now lies fifth.
 Share 16m ago 13.16 EST Lap 54/71 Russell, now third, has Hadjar looking to attack, the gap 0.2s, and he’s beaten on the inside; meantime, Antonelli comes in and Norris oozes past. He’ll take some stoping from here.
 Share 17m ago 13.14 EST Lap 53/71 Norris is taking half a second a lap out of Antonelli, the gap down to 4.7s; Verstappen is a further 7.4s behind.
 Share 18m ago 13.13 EST Lap 52/71 Piastri pits, while Norris closes the gap on Antonelli, now 6.1s. He’s moving nicely.
 Share 19m ago 13.12 EST Lap 51/71 Now Hadjar pits and, when he comes out, Russell goes by. Norris is now up into second, 7.7s behind Antonelli, who’ll have to pit shortly.
 Share 21m ago 13.11 EST Lap 50/71 Norris pits so Hadjar leads from Antonelli … and Norris rejoins the race in fourth. He’ll need a couple of lap for his tyres to get warm, whereupon the race will be decided; who’s quicker, him or Verstappen?
 View image in fullscreen McLaren driver Lando Norris in the pits. Photograph: Nelson Almeida/Pool AFP/AP Share Updated at  13.32 EST 22m ago 13.09 EST Lap 49/71 Verstappen sets a fastest lap and is driving at 1.4s faster than Norris. It’s 81s to Piastri in fourth, but he’ll surely come in soon.
 Share 23m ago 13.08 EST Lap 48/71 Norris has already put a second on his lead over Hadjar, but it’s just started raining; might Verstappen’s cross prove to be well-timed, his tyres nice, fresh and warm?
 Share 25m ago 13.07 EST Lap 47/71 Verstappen emerges fifth, the gap from Norris to Hadjar 12.8s. I imagine we’ll see the leader in shortly.
 Share 26m ago 13.05 EST Lap 46/71 Yup, in comes Verstappen, the lead now 12.4s, while Russell, who’s been threatening it for a while, finally takes out Lawson around the outside to move sixth.
 Share 27m ago 13.04 EST Lap 45/71 Gosh, Norris is flying, now 11.2s ahead of Verstappen; I doubt he’ll come in before Red Bull, who need to force the issue.
 Share 28m ago 13.03 EST Lap 44/71 Let’s run down the leaderboard:
 1 Norris
 2 Verstappen
 3 Hadjar
 4 Antonelli
 5 Piastri
 6 Lawson
 7 Russell
 8 Hulkenberg
 9 Lindlblad
 10 Leclerc
 11 Alonso
 12 Hamilton
 Share 29m ago 13.02 EST Lap 43/71 Told that Norris is thinking about going to the end without aa pit, Verstapen is emphatic in his refusal. I wonder if was a ruse from the leader to try and force his pursuer to make a bad call.
 Share 30m ago 13.01 EST Lap 42/71 Russell is now 2.8s behind Lawson, while Albon, 12th, is given a 10-second penalty for re-entering the race unsafely after a pit. Norris leads by 10.8s.
 Share 32m ago 13.00 EST Lap 41/71 Norris continues building his lead, while Russell sets another fastest lap. Hamilton, though, is behind Norris, lapped when pitting, but he must just have the pace to unlap himself.
 Share 33m ago 12.58 EST Lap 40/71 Russell sets a fastest lap, but it’s roughly four seconds to Lawson in sixth; rather than close the gap to Norris, Verstappen sees him extend it to 10.0s.
 Share Updated at  13.00 EST 35m ago 12.57 EST Lap 39/71 Just when we think Hamilton is going at Hulkenberg, he pits, Norris now leading by 9.4s.
 Share 36m ago 12.56 EST Lap 38/71 Other hand, if it rains, Verstappen has a chance of catching him, and Hadjar is told by the team to move over, his dream of a first P2 dashed by orders.
 View image in fullscreen Max Verstappen, in the Oracle Red Bull Racing RB22, leads team mate Isack Hadjar Photograph: Mark Thompson/Getty Images Share Updated at  13.25 EST 37m ago 12.55 EST Lap 37/71 Hamilton has hit a groove, just 0.3 behind Hulkenberg in eighth – the gap was once eight seconds. Norris now leads by 8.8s, and he’s moving towards victory, provided he can avoid disaster.
 Share 38m ago 12.53 EST Lap 36/71 Alonso has a hole in his nose-tip following a clash with Bearman at the start, but he’s doing alright for now; Norris’ lead is up to 7.7s.
 Share Updated at  12.53 EST 40m ago 12.52 EST Lap 35/71 Norris is making this looks easy, the lead up to 7.4s, while Verstappen has found a bit more pace, just 1.0s behind Hadjar. Onsalaught incoming…
 Share Updated at  12.52 EST 41m ago 12.51 EST Lap 34/71 Alonso goes wide, off the track … and back ahead of Albon, into 11th; Norris now leads by 7s.
 Share 42m ago 12.49 EST Lap 33/71 Things seem to have stabilised a little, Norris extending his lead, Hadjar unable to make an impression, just as Verstappen can’t on him. It’s then a full eight seconds to Antonelli in fourth.
 Share 44m ago 12.48 EST Lap 32/71 Stroll, 20th, is into the pit … and once again, his Aston won’t get him home, their 21st DNF of the season. Norris, meantime, extends his lead to 5.2s; Hadjar can’t get close to him currently.
 Share 45m ago 12.47 EST Lap 31/71 Verstappen has a problem with his downward force, so can’t get at his teammate Hadjar, 46s behind Norris and 3.5s ahead of him.
 Share 46m ago 12.45 EST Lap 30/71 Russell tries Hulkenberg on the outside and around a corner, where he’s got more speed – on the straight, he’s not finding it as easy. And past he goes, taking seventh place.
 Share 47m ago 12.44 EST Lap 29/71 Hamilton again goes at Lindblad and he’s past into ninth while, at the front, Norris is building a lead, 4.9s in front.
 Share 48m ago 12.43 EST Lap 28/71 Russell, 0.3s off Hulkenberg, can’t force his way past and into seventh, but it surely won’t be long – wily though Hulkenberg is.
 Share 49m ago 12.42 EST Lap 27/71 Now Hamilton moves back past Albon to reclaim 10th, while Leclerc has no rear-tryre temperature. He’s 14th.
 View image in fullscreen Lewis Hamilton in action in the Ferrari SF-26. Photograph: Clive Mason/Getty Images Share Updated at  13.03 EST 50m ago 12.41 EST Lap 26/71 Norris now leads by 3.4s, with Verstappen a further 4.6s behind second-placed Hadjar. It’s then 4.6s more to Antonelli, and then 10.5 to Piastri in fifth.
 Share Updated at  12.44 EST 52m ago 12.39 EST Lap 25/71 Also struggling is Hamilton, dropping further behind Lindblad, who has a go at Albon … and moves by into ninth! Antonelli, told to reset, says he can’t turn on the left corners, but his team can’t find anything amiss in the data.
 Share 54m ago 12.38 EST Lap 24/71 Norris enjoys the clean air in front of him, moving 3.2 ahead of Hadjar while Verstappen attacks Antonelli … and breezes by! The champ is really struggling to control his car.
 Share 55m ago 12.36 EST Lap 23/71 Let’s run down the leaderboard:
 1 Norris
 2 Hadjar
 3 Antonelli
 4 Verstappen
 5 Lawson
 6 Piastri
 7 Hulkenberg
 8 Russell
 9 Albon
 10 Lindblad
 11 Hamilton
 Share 1h ago 12.35 EST Lap 22/71 Hadjar has never finished higher than third, but it’s Verstappen running fastest; he sets a fastest lap and is just a second off Antonelli.
 Share 1h ago 12.34 EST Lap 21/71 Antonelli is in all sorts whereas Hadjar is in flow … and he too gets past. Looking at a recording of the spin, he’s got nae grip, and Verstappen can see him now; good luck, old mate.
 Share 1h ago 12.33 EST ANTONELLI SPINS!
 Lap 20/71 Antonelli extends his lead, tyres warm … BUT HE SPINS! He’d just complained about suspension but his team assured him it was tyre temperature … and Norris goes past into P1! The gap is 3.3s!
 Share 1h ago 12.31 EST Lap 19/71 Norris, with tyres a lap warmer than Antonelli, cuts the leads to 0.483s. Can he get while the going’s good? Not thus far.
 Share Updated at  12.31 EST 1h ago 12.29 EST Lap 18/71 Now Antonelli pits but will he come out ahead of Norris? Yes he will, the lad down to two 1.1s. This is a different race now.
 Share 1h ago 12.28 EST Lap 17/71 The other teams will have noticed Hamilton’s pace there, and a slew of stops ensure, Norris, Russell, Hadjar, Lawson Piastri and Hulkenberg all go in … with Russell spinning! He almost nails his wing, but loses time, coming out 10th.
 Share 1h ago 12.26 EST Lap 16/71 In 13th, Alonso is giving Leclerc plenty, then he moves up a spot when Albon pits. Hamilton, meantime, is moving much more smoothly now, setting the fastest time for the final sector.
 Share 1h ago 12.25 EST Lap 15/71 Norris closes the gap behind Antonelli to 6.9s, then Hamilton, who’s wanted to pit for several laps, is ordered in; he goes to softs and comes out last … oh but Sainz is in there too. Bottas, by the way, is out of the race.
 Share 1h ago 12.24 EST Lap 14/71 We’re getting towards the first round of stops; will anyone try slicks from here until the end? There’s a fair bit of shpritz kicking up, but the lack of grip might be a problem.
 Share 1h ago 12.23 EST Lap 13/71 The top seven are well clear now, Hulkenberg 7.3s behind Piastri in seventh. Antonelli now leads Norris by 8.2s.
 Share 1h ago 12.22 EST Lap 12/71 Antonelli has stepped on it, now 8.0s in front of Norris – he’s been serene away from the drama. Russell is third, Hadjar fourth, Verstappen fifth; I quite fancy him for a podium here, he’s attacking this race like a madman.
 View image in fullscreen Kimi Antonelli leads Lando Norris and Liam Lawson of New Zealand of Racing Bulls Photograph: Ryan Pierse/Getty Images Share Updated at  12.24 EST 1h ago 12.20 EST Lap 11/71 Hadjar looked up for this from the start and he blitzes Lawson down the inside, moving into fourth; Verstappen goes past too.
 Share 1h ago 12.18 EST Lap 10/71 The two Ferraris dogfight, Hamilton on the inside, Leclerc on the right … and it’s Hamilton struggling, easily passed. His car isn’t doing what he wants, I don’t think, because that was too easy given how brilliant a driver he is.
 Share 1h ago 12.17 EST Lap 9/71 Piastri thinks Hulkenberg leaves him the inside, attacks … and past he goes. Antonelli leads by 4.7s.
 Share 1h ago 12.15 EST Lap 8/71 And now Russell passes Lawson, moving into fourth, while Versatappen passes Hulkenberg; Hamilton is told by his team to allow Bearman past, rather than face a 10-second penalty, so he does.
